issues.detail: Hebrew 'חֹלֲלָה יָדוֹ נָחָשׁ בָּרִיחַ' means 'His hand pierced the fleeing serpent' (or 'formed/coiled the fleeing serpent'), not 'tay Ngài đấm lũng con rắn hùng mạnh' ('His hand punched through the mighty serpent'). The verb 'חולל' here is 'pierced' or 'writhed/formed', not 'đấm lũng' (punched through), and 'בָּרִיחַ' means 'fleeing' or 'bar' (as in a fleeing serpent), not 'hùng mạnh' (mighty). This changes the imagery and meaning.
